passes.name: Skill Check authoring and assessment-map validation

semanticValidation.method: A full prospective beginner-integrity review inspected each selected destination or authored Studio section, traced all 280 questions to current Core Study, separately audited all 28 required Builds for hidden prerequisites, audited every weekly workload, and adversarially reviewed the complete research-to-portfolio capability chain. Deterministic validators only verify this authored evidence.
findingsReviewed: Repaired beginner tool risk by choosing Figma Starter as primary, excluding paid Dev Mode from requirements, and teaching manual handoff.
Repaired documentation-overload risk by adding a concise active Studio Exercise every Week and assigning documentation only to exact sections or reference use.
Repaired fictional-research risk by requiring real participants where feasible and explicitly labeled secondary or simulated evidence otherwise.
Repaired premature-polish risk by sequencing briefs, evidence, research, synthesis, flows, sketches, and wireframes before high-fidelity systems.

Repaired UI-heavy imbalance through five research/problem-definition Weeks and repeated usability evidence; repaired UX-heavy imbalance through five visual/responsive-system Weeks and continuous craft criteria.
Repaired late accessibility risk by integrating accessibility implications in every Build and adding a dedicated WCAG-aware audit before handoff and capstone delivery.

Repaired capstone dependency risk by requiring earlier practice in every research, visual, interaction, responsive, system, testing, accessibility, handoff, metrics, and presentation capability used by the capstone.
Repaired portfolio credibility risk by prohibiting invented users, quotes, personas, metrics, and outcomes and requiring explicit evidence limits.

Repaired audit-language ambiguity by distinguishing point-of-use practice with authoritative references from the separate active Studio lab; learner roles and evidence now describe the actual activity precisely.
